newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slightly firmer in line with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slightly firmer in line with crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha was slightly firmer on Thursday in line with stronger crude but in a lacklustre market, traders said.
Swaps were assessed at around $190.50/$191.50 for June paper.
Traders said at two high quality naphtha cargoes still appeared to be in the market. They put price levels around quotes cif hi +$2.0/$3.0 basis Rotterdam.

One player said he was offering a small amount of light naphtha barrels, but said it was difficult to ascertain price levels. Other traders pegged fob barrel prices around $179/$184. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
